entities.summary: Adelheid Franziska Z’graggen commonly known as Heidi Z’graggen is a Swiss political scientist and politician who currently serves on the Council of States (Switzerland) for The Centre since 2019. She previously served on the Executive Council of Uri between 2004 and 2020. In 2018, she was briefly a candidate for Federal Council (Switzerland) to succeed Doris Leuthard.
